description.text:
## Technical design

Shared sections below. The others, and the spec's Constraints, are in the issues that use them: Constraints, Repository and tooling, Prerequisites and CI in story BREW-4; Frontend in every story with UI work except BREW-4, whose frontend subtasks are Done; UI implementation in subtask BREW-87 (`jira.mjs read BREW-87`), its later "Focus rings" and "Icon build script" bullets quoted in BREW-93 and BREW-91; Deployment in BREW-89; Seams and tests in BREW-10; Hard logic in BREW-10, BREW-28, BREW-32, BREW-42, BREW-46 and BREW-69.

issues.summary: Frontend scaffold, routes and frontend CI
Design foundation: tokens, palettes, Material theme, button overrides, fonts
Icon sprite, icon registration and landing photos
Shared style helpers in helpers.scss
Landing page
Backend scaffold, schema, seed and backend CI
Docker Compose, Playwright e2e, e2e CI and README
Fix: CI workflows: named steps, contents: read, e2e paths, npm audit gate with typescript-eslint 8.74.0
Fix: compose db published on 127.0.0.1 only
Fix: SchemaIT names the violated check constraints; test reset replays 002-seed-methods.sql
Fix: icon build script reads icons.js as data with an allow-list; sprite allow-list test
Fix: brand-mark test starts from the scrolled-down page
Fix: keyboard focus rings, ivory in the hero (R45)
See my brews in the journal

Frontend: models, BrewApi.list, format helpers, JournalStore
Brew card, method icon and bean rating (display)
Journal page with count, grid, footer and pagination
Fix: JpaSpecificationExecutor on BrewRepository, findAllWithBrewCount() on BrewMethodRepository
Fix: count and footer text in body-sm muted, footer stacked under the pagination on phones
Fix: current page stays an espresso circle with its ivory number on hover
Fix: pagination aria-labels: "Pages, page x of y" on the nav, "Previous page" and "Next page" on the arrows
Journal loading and error states
Skeleton cards and load-error panel with Try again
Log a brew
Backend: GET /api/methods with brew counts
Backend: POST /api/brews with trimming
Frontend: MethodApi, MethodStore, BrewApi.create, Toaster
Bean rating input and method select controls
Brew form in create mode
Open the form from the journal, empty state, toast and highlight, e2e
Validate a brew before saving
Backend: brew validation and 400 field errors
Frontend: client validators, error messages, API error parser
Brew form: inline errors, summary banner, notes counter
Save safely: duplicate names, deleted methods, failures, unsaved changes

Brew form: duplicate-name, method-gone and server-error states, e2e
Brew form: "Discard changes?" guard
Edit a brew
Backend: PATCH /api/brews/{id} with merge-patch semantics
Frontend: BrewApi.patch and changedFields
Card menu "Edit brew", form edit mode and brew-gone state, e2e
Delete a brew
Backend: DELETE /api/brews/{id}
Delete confirmation dialog and reload after delete
Card menu "Delete brew", toast and page handling, e2e
See a brew's details
Brew detail dialog opened from the card
Search my brews
Backend: name search with literal % and _
Frontend: debounced search in the store and the URL
Toolbar search, search chip, filtered count and no-results panel, e2e

Toolbar Sort select, store and URL, e2e

Backend: method, roast and minimum-rating filters
Toolbar filters, chips, store and URL
Phone Filters button, badge and "Filter & sort" sheet, e2e

Frontend: strict URL parsing, cleaning and last-page fallback
Journal page: two-way URL sync, Back/reload, scroll, e2e
Add brew methods

Frontend: MethodApi.create, MethodStore.add, dialog order, name checks and messages
Brew methods dialog: list, add, load error, entry points, e2e
Add a method from the brew form
"+ Add new method…" inline box in the method select
Rename a method

Methods dialog: inline rename
Confirm renames of methods with brews
Backend: GET /api/methods/{id}/brews
Rename step view in the methods dialog, e2e
Delete a method and protect "Other"

Methods dialog: delete a method without brews, protected "Other"
Reassign brews when deleting a method
Delete step view with per-brew targets and summary
Wire the delete step into the methods dialog, e2e
Methods changed elsewhere
Methods dialog: method gone (404) handling
Reload method data on close; open form switches a deleted method to "Other"
Clear answers for missing items and malformed requests
Not-found and malformed-body contract on every endpoint and screen
Use Brewlog on a phone
Breakpoint service and phone pagination
Bottom sheets for form, detail and methods on phones
E2E checks of phone, tablet and desktop layouts
Page through a long journal
Truncated desktop pagination with page gaps
